condition.notes: Desktop RAM VRM or PCH VCC missing. Same first-step workflow as laptop bucks: resistance first.

next_steps.action: Unplug the PSU from mains. Wait 60 s. Measure resistance from the rail to ground.

measure.where: Rail test point or VRM inductor output pad
measure.instrument: DMM resistance mode (200 ohm then 2 kohm)
measure.expected: RAM VRM typically >50 ohm; PCH VCC typically >50 ohm. <10 ohm indicates a hard short.
measure.safety: Unplug from mains and wait for bulk caps to discharge.

interpretations.then: Hard short on the rail. Do NOT apply power. Hunt the shorted component (output cap, low-side FET, load IC) before any further diagnosis.
No short. Proceed to check the rail's input supply (ATX_3V3 for both RAM_VRM and PCH_VCC on most desktop boards).
